summary: A grown child avoids politics with a conservative father, waits out the news and hears his questions as traps.
realLife: In a recorded father and daughter talk, she tries to dodge political talk and lets the news play, waiting silently for the politicians to leave the screen. He says his questions are sincere, that he trusts her as better educated and does not need to agree to respect her. She hears teasing and an attempt to prove her wrong, gets exasperated, then admits she fears he no longer likes her. It ends on pride and affection from both.
sources: https://www.mprnews.org/story/2016/11/04/npr-election-family-feud (NPR family political therapy piece, father and daughter, via MPR)
